project_name: MONEYTRACE - Cagayan de Oro City & Misamis Oriental Public Expenditure Screening & AI Advisory Portal

design_philosophy.identity: Government-grade civic tech intelligence console with high visual authority, density, and institutional clarity.

dual_experience.internal_console: Dark Slate Command Hub (Slate 950 / Slate 900 base, crisp border lines, high-density data matrices, status-driven alert chips, dedicated Claude AI Advisory drawer). Designed for fast triage, audit verification, and rule-threshold management.
dual_experience.public_portal: Warm Civic Transparency Portal (Slate 50 / Warm Off-White base, Emerald & Gold civic trust accents, clear visual indicator banner 'Flags are screening indicators, not proof of wrongdoing', read-only open contracting cards).

principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss editorial typography meets dense Bloomberg-style audit tracking and clean civic GIS map visuals.
Restrained Alert Palette: Gray/Slate background with muted alert surfaces; bright colors (Green, Yellow, Orange, Red) used ONLY on dedicated indicator chips, status badges, and map markers.
Density with Scannability: Sticky filter headers, zero-waste table cells, fixed column widths, optical alignment, subgrid layouts.
AI Transparency: Claude Advisory responses clearly marked with Sparkle/Advisory badge and distinct backdrop tint to separate human record from AI narrative context.

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

F1.name: Budget Increase
F1.tooltip: F1: Expenditure exceeds initial budget allocation by >15% without prior amendment approval.

F2.name: Modifications
F2.tooltip: F2: Project scope or timeline modified more than 3 times within a single fiscal quarter.

F3.name: Payment Discrepancy
F3.tooltip: F3: Discrepancy detected between disbursed milestone payment and verified physical progress.

F4.name: Statistical Outlier
F4.tooltip: F4: Cost per unit/km deviates by more than 2.5 standard deviations from regional benchmark.

F5.name: Schedule Overdue
F5.tooltip: F5: Construction milestone overdue by over 60 calendar days without filed force majeure.

F6.name: Geo Pending
F6.tooltip: F6: Mandatory GIS coordinate verification or aerial site imagery missing from audit file.

layout_and_grids.desktop_split: Side-by-side layout on desktop: Left side 65% width sticky table + sticky filter bar, Right side 35% fixed height interactive Leaflet Map.
layout_and_grids.mobile_view: Tabbed layout on mobile: [Projects Table] / [Interactive Map] / [Analytics Summary].
layout_and_grids.bento_dashboard: Grid cols 12: Hero stats (4 cols x 3 cards), Heatmap by Municipality (8 cols), Flag Distribution Chart (4 cols), Recent Audit Activity Feed (4 cols), AI Insights Panel (4 cols).
layout_and_grids.container_padding: Console: px-4 py-4 md:px-6 md:py-6 (High density). Public Portal: px-6 py-8 md:px-12 md:py-12 (Generous Swiss breathing space).

components_and_features.navigation: Top fixed navbar with Brand Logo (MONEYTRACE + CDO/Misamis Seal badge), Mode Switcher (Console vs Public), Search trigger, Role Badge (Admin / Reviewer / Guest), and Notifications Bell with unread counter.
components_and_features.sticky_filter_bar: Sticky horizontal filter bar with Select boxes (Agency, Municipality, Project Type, Status, Alert Level) and interactive Flag Chip Toggles (F1-F6) with instant count badges.
components_and_features.scannable_table: Dense data table with sortable columns: Alert Chip, Project Title, Implementing Agency, Location, Approved Budget, Disbursed Amount, Active Flags (with tooltip icons), Status, Actions.
components_and_features.leaflet_map: Custom styled Leaflet + OpenStreetMap container with colored pin markers matching alert levels (Green/Yellow/Orange/Red), popup cards with mini financials & direct link to project detail modal or page.
components_and_features.claude_ai_advisory: Advisory drawer / side panel styled with subtle violet-tinted gradient border, presenting structured sections: Risk Summary, Anomaly Rationale, Audit Questions to Ask Contractor, Recommended Reviewer Action, Draft Change Request text.
components_and_features.audit_trail: Immutable, append-only log table displaying timestamp, actor name/role, action type (FLAG_TRIGGERED, VERIFICATION_FILE, CHANGE_REQUESTED, APPROVED, PUBLISHED), and delta state.
components_and_features.sensitive_edit_workflow: Two-step approval modal: Reviewer requests edit → Claude drafts change context & risk score → Second Senior Reviewer / Admin reviews in queue → Approve / Return / Reject with recorded justification.
components_and_features.rule_config_ui: Admin control page with slider controls for F1-F6 thresholds (e.g., F1 percentage threshold slider 5%-50%, F5 overdue days slider 15-120 days) with real-time recalculation preview.
components_and_features.data_import_screen: Drag and drop CSV/XLSX dropzone with client-side column mapping, data validation parser, preview matrix, error line highlighter, and batch flag computation button.
components_and_features.public_disclaimer_banner: High-visibility warning banner at top of Public Portal: 'NOTICE: Flagged indicators are automated screening markers derived from public records, not proof of financial wrongdoing or corruption.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Internal Reviewer Console and Public Transparency Portal are fully implemented and accessible via seamless top bar switcher or navigation tabs.

Implement mock datasets covering real Cagayan de Oro City & Misamis Oriental infrastructure projects (e.g., Macabalan Coastal Bypass Road, CDO River Flood Risk Management Project, Carmen Bridge Rehab, El Salvador City Public Market, Gingoog Water System).
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select triggers, table rows, flag chips, modal triggers, tabs) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide-react or Radix icons for UI symbols; avoid raw AI emojis in control surfaces.
Ensure F1-F6 flag tooltips use Shadcn Tooltip components so users can hovering any chip to instantly read the triggering logic.
Leaflet map must include custom marker clusters or colored SVGs matching Green, Yellow, Orange, Red alert levels.
Claude AI Advisory panel must generate interactive advisory breakdowns with copyable draft text for audit notes.
Recharts visual analytics must include Alert Distribution Pie Chart, Budget spent by Agency Bar Chart, and Municipality Risk Heatmap Matrix.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: Mandatory on all buttons, links, search bars, table rows, filter dropdowns, flag chips, map pins, tabs, and action dialogs (e.g., data-testid='filter-agency-select', data-testid='flag-chip-f1', data-testid='project-row-cdo-101').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not use 'transition: all' globally. Use target transitions like 'transition-colors duration-200' or 'transition-opacity duration-150'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_center_app_container: Do not center align the app container globally. Maintain structural grid left-alignment for scannability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: All text elements over badges, overlays, and tables must satisfy minimum APCA/WCAG contrast standards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use Sonner toast component (/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for state feedback on flag verifications, data uploads, and approvals.
